body_html:
@protohedgehog Did you see this https://everipedia.org/ I could see an #openscience offshoot. Or a multiuser @withknown or micro.blog site and just use resource tags (journal, data, experiment). That could be launched in ten minutes.

If I rememeber correctly I think I saw you as a leading a #globalsprint for @mozilla coming up. Been awhile since I scrolled through repo but I think I remember this plan.
